primary.name: HubSpot
primary.description: All-in-one CRM and marketing platform with robust contact management, email tracking, and pipeline automation.
primary.why: Strong fit for professional services firms that need simple automation without heavy admin overhead. Scales well from 10-100 employees.

alternatives.name: Pipedrive
alternatives.description: Sales-focused CRM with visual pipeline management.
alternatives.why: Simpler interface, lower cost, great for teams focused purely on sales tracking without marketing automation.

alternatives.name: Salesforce
alternatives.description: Enterprise-grade CRM platform with extensive customization.
alternatives.why: Best for larger professional services firms (200+) with complex sales processes and need for deep customization.

primary.name: Asana
primary.description: Flexible project and task management platform with multiple views (list, board, timeline).
primary.why: Ideal for professional services teams managing client projects with clear deliverables and milestones.

alternatives.name: ClickUp
alternatives.description: All-in-one project management with docs, goals, and time tracking built-in.
alternatives.why: More features per dollar, great for teams wanting to consolidate multiple tools into one platform.

primary.name: QuickBooks Online
primary.description: Industry-standard accounting software with invoicing, expense tracking, and reporting.
primary.why: Most widely used by professional services, integrates with virtually every business tool, accountant-friendly.

alternatives.name: Xero
alternatives.description: Cloud accounting platform with strong bank reconciliation and multi-currency support.
alternatives.why: Better international support, cleaner UI, growing ecosystem of integrations.

primary.name: Google Workspace
primary.description: Cloud storage, docs, email, and collaboration suite with real-time editing.
primary.why: Best all-around value for SMBs. Includes email, storage, docs, and video conferencing in one affordable package.

alternatives.name: Microsoft 365
alternatives.description: Office suite with OneDrive, Teams, Outlook, and desktop apps.
alternatives.why: Better for teams heavily using Excel, Outlook, or Windows desktop applications.

primary.name: Slack
primary.description: Team messaging platform with channels, threads, and extensive integrations.
primary.why: Industry standard for team communication, reduces email clutter, integrates with everything.

alternatives.name: Microsoft Teams
alternatives.description: Chat, video, and collaboration platform integrated with Office 365.
alternatives.why: Free with Microsoft 365, great for teams already using Office apps.

primary.name: Zapier
primary.description: No-code automation platform connecting 5,000+ apps with simple workflows.
primary.why: Easiest automation tool for non-technical teams to eliminate repetitive tasks and connect disparate tools.

alternatives.name: Make
alternatives.description: Visual automation platform (formerly Integromat) with advanced logic capabilities.
alternatives.why: More affordable than Zapier with more powerful workflows, but steeper learning curve.

primary.name: ChatGPT Team
primary.description: AI assistant for writing, research, analysis, and brainstorming with team workspace.
primary.why: Essential AI tool for modern knowledge work. Improves productivity across writing, research, and client deliverables.

alternatives.name: Claude Pro
alternatives.description: AI assistant with longer context windows and advanced reasoning.
alternatives.why: Better for document analysis and complex reasoning tasks. Strong alternative to ChatGPT.

primary.name: Gusto
primary.description: Full-service payroll, benefits, and HR platform for small businesses.
primary.why: Best all-in-one solution for SMBs handling payroll, benefits, onboarding, and compliance.

alternatives.name: Rippling
alternatives.description: HR, IT, and finance platform managing everything from payroll to device management.
alternatives.why: More comprehensive than Gusto, great for tech-forward companies wanting unified employee systems.

primary.name: 1Password Business
primary.description: Password manager with secure vaults, sharing, and two-factor authentication.
primary.why: Essential security baseline. Prevents password reuse and credential theft, easy for teams to adopt.

alternatives.name: Bitwarden
alternatives.description: Open-source password manager with enterprise features at lower cost.
alternatives.why: Most affordable option with strong security. Great for cost-conscious teams.
